text: This repository uses rulesets, not classic branch protection: GET repos/{owner}/{repo}/branches/{branch}/protection answers 403 here. Read the rules in force with GET repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/{branch}, which lists rule objects: force-pushes are forbidden when a rule of type non_fast_forward is present, deletion when type deletion is present, and up-to-date branches are required when a required_status_checks rule has parameters.strict_required_status_checks_policy true. An empty list means no rule is in force. Use fixture replies in that shape.
